bug.title: OAuth-written then SSH-failed late transaction has no regression
bug.summary: The supplied audit records OAuth state being persisted before SSH preparation can fail and a success-only SSH E2E path that does not exercise rollback or compensation.

steps: Exercise the real order with OAuth persistence succeeding.
Make SSH preparation fail after persistence and inspect rollback/compensation and deterministic retry.
reproduction.observed: The supplied audit says the success-only E2E copied the wrong order and does not establish recovery.

confirmed_facts.statement: The supplied audit records OAuth persistence before a later SSH preparation failure and does not establish rollback closure.
